title: The 'no backoff sleeps' assertion `recordedSleeps.every((ms) => ms <= 1_000)` i…
description:
The 'no backoff sleeps' assertion `recordedSleeps.every((ms) => ms <= 1_000)` is weaker than intended in isolation: with the default retryBaseMs=300 the first retry backoff (~300-600 ms) would slip under the 1000 ms poll-interval bound. It is not load-bearing on its own, but the adjacent `geometrySamplerCalls === 0` assertion is airtight (any verify/retry iteration samples geometry), so the acceptance criterion is fully satisfied. Consider asserting recordedSleeps contains no value distinguishable from a poll-interval sleep, or drop it in favor of the sampler guard.
